title: Network-Adaptive Instrumental Variables
abstract: arXiv:2611.25222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Three mechanisms generate endogeneity in regressions under interference. We address them by constructing network-adaptive instrumental variables (NIV) for a spatial autoregressive (SAR) model with endogenous covariates and unknown network weights. Under network-conditional exclusion and information equivalence, the resulting instruments yield valid moments without knowing the true network. We establish joint identification of the structural mean coefficients and the network parameters, providing two sufficient routes. Then under additional covariance restrictions, we identify the disturbance spillover coefficient and the innovation variance. We develop NIV-GMM estimation, establish consistency and asymptotic normality, and give feasible inference and a test for mean network spillovers. Monte Carlo simulations examine their finite-sample performance.

translated_abstract: 在存在干扰（相互影响）的回归中，有三种机制会产生内生性。我们通过为一个具有内生协变量和未知网络权重的空间自回归（SAR）模型构建网络自适应工具变量（NIV）来解决这些问题。在网络条件排除性约束和信息等价条件下，所得工具变量在不知道真实网络的情况下也能产生有效的矩条件。我们建立了结构均值系数与网络参数的联合识别，并提供了两条充分的识别路径。随后，在额外的协方差限制下，我们识别了扰动项溢出系数和创新项方差。我们发展了NIV-GMM估计方法，证明了一致性和渐近正态性，并给出了可行的统计推断方法以及针对均值网络溢出效应的检验。蒙特卡洛模拟考察了这些方法的有限样本表现。
tldr: 该论文提出网络自适应工具变量（NIV）方法，在真实网络结构未知的情况下解决干扰环境中的内生性问题，实现了空间自回归模型结构系数与网络参数的联合识别、GMM估计及溢出效应的有效推断与检验。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes network-adaptive instrumental variables (NIV) that address endogeneity under interference without knowing the true network, jointly identifying and estimating structural coefficients and network parameters in SAR models via NIV-GMM with valid inference and spillover tests.
